verdict: OSD task sequence failed at `Setup Windows and ConfigMgr` because a custom `SetupComplete.cmd` was placed in the image. MECM OSD reserves `SetupComplete.cmd` for TS continuation and overwriting it breaks the hand-off from WinPE to full OS.
fix: Remove any custom `SetupComplete.cmd` delivered by earlier TS steps or baked into the WIM. Move whatever work it did into task-sequence steps instead (a `Run Command Line` or `Run PowerShell Script` step between `Apply Operating System` and `Setup Windows and ConfigMgr`). If the custom file is in a reference image, rebuild the image without it; MECM owns that filename for the duration of OSD.
